items.title: Special Weather Statement issued May 21 at 7:21AM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
items.summary:
At 720 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a cluster of strong
thunderstorms along a line extending from 16 miles south of Amelia to
7 miles west of Cocodrie. Movement was northeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Winds up to 30 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Houma, Dulac, Montegut, Chauvin, Cocodrie, and Lumcon Center Buoy.
